Download

Thanks for downloading Clipsa

Clipsa 0.1.5 for Windows (Clipsa_0.1.5_x64-setup.exe) is downloading from GitHub Releases. If nothing happens, use the button below.

Download again What's new in 0.1.5

Also for Windows: MSI package (.msi) · all files on GitHub

Install

Three steps to your first paste

  1. 1

    Run the installer

    Open Clipsa_0.1.5_x64-setup.exe from your Downloads. Clipsa isn't code-signed for Windows yet, so SmartScreen may say it protected your PC: choose More info, then Run anyway.
  2. 2

    Start Clipsa

    Open Clipsa from the Start menu. It lives in the system tray (look under the ^ arrow) and keeps running when you close its window.
  3. 3

    Open the picker

    The welcome screen asks whether Clipsa may check for updates. Then press Ctrl Shift V in any app to open the quick picker, and Enter to paste.

Verify

Check what you downloaded

Every installer is built by Clipsa's public release workflow and published with a SHA256SUMS file on the GitHub release. To compare your download with it:

cd ~\Downloads
$hash = (Get-FileHash .\Clipsa_0.1.5_x64-setup.exe).Hash.ToLower()
curl.exe -fsSL https://github.com/mordamax/clipsa/releases/download/v0.1.5/SHA256SUMS | Select-String $hash

In PowerShell. It prints the line for Clipsa_0.1.5_x64-setup.exe when the file matches, and nothing when it doesn't. The same SHA-256 is listed next to each file on the release page.
